text_block_list.text:
I decided to let Sakura Bakushin O rest in 
the infirmary as she was getting tired.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Rest is an honor student's duty, you know! 
Right then, good night!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmu, where in the world…?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yikes! Look, look, look! It's Ms. Sakura 
Bakushin O, our class president!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
It's your chance to say hello! Good 
morning! Class president!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's this!? What an ideal greeting! A 
very good morning to you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Prime Minister from Somewhere
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O, your excellence is 
famous even in my country!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oyaya, you're that foreign guy who's on TV 
a lot…!?

text_block_list.name: Royalty from Somewhere
text_block_list.text:
You are just magnificent! We're all 
Bakushin-ing, following your example!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fu… Of course, you're right, spaceman. 
After all, I am――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am the honor student of the world! Class 
president of the galaxy! I am Sakura 
Bakushin O!!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Wow…! Bakushin O! Bakushin O!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, everybody! Pure! Righteous! 
Bakushinbakushiiiiiiiiin!!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ha! It seems to have been a dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But the class president, is a role model 
for the world……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This must be a prophetic dream!!

Waking up in a great mood, Sakura Bakushin 
O seems to have had enough rest.

text_block_list.name: Prime Minister from Somewhere
text_block_list.text:
… I'm sorry to say, but it seems that 
there is a girl more qualified to be class 
president than you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wh…… What did you say――!?

text_block_list.name: Royalty from Somewhere
text_block_list.text:
Next election, a clean vote. I'm going to 
vote for that other girl……

text_block_list.name: Alien
text_block_list.text:
※×＠■〇～…… Well, something like that. See 
ya later!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ha, a dream!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Agghhh～! I have to work harder and harder 
to be worthy of being class president～……!

Sakura Bakushin O couldn't get much rest 
because her shoulders were so tense from 
her dream.
